sentence_stem: Far from being a mere formality,
correct_completion: the audit uncovered serious irregularities in the accounts.
full_sentence: Far from being a mere formality, the audit uncovered serious irregularities in the accounts.
acceptable_variants: the audit revealed major problems with the records.
the audit exposed several serious errors in the accounts.

options.text: the audit was carried out by three staff members.
options.why_wrong: This only states who did the work. It is neutral information and does not contrast with the idea of a mere formality.

options.text: so the auditors signed off without reading the files.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, which does not fit the contrast set up by 'far from being'. It also repeats the idea of a formality instead of opposing it.

options.text: the audit uncovered serious irregularities in the accounts.
because the deadline had already passed.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' signals a cause. The structure 'far from being' needs a contrasting clause about the content of the audit, so a cause clause does not complete it.

grammar_focus: Contrastive structure 'far from being' followed by a main clause describing the contrasting result
explanation: After 'far from being', the sentence needs a main clause that contrasts with the idea of a formality. Only the option describing serious findings does this; the other options give neutral facts, a result, or a cause.
translation: Daleko od bycia zwykłą formalnością audyt ujawnił poważne nieprawidłowości w księgach.
